name: Kin Island Metropolis & Hotel
summary: Step into Kin Island (Three Island), the bustling trade hub of the Sevii Islands. Check in at the Kin Island Hotel — the sole luxury lodge in the archipelago. Visit the EV Berry Vendor to stock up on effort-value reduction berries for exact stat tuning. Thoroughly search the city perimeter to discover four Nuggets, two Heart Scales, a Star Piece, PP Max, a Prism Scale, and TM114 Leech Life down the western alleyway. Use the Poké Radar in the lush coastal grass to catch rare wild Whimsicott.
